=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text tpush "push "
text tpop "pop "
text tpeek "peek "
text tempty "empty: "
text tsize "size "
text tyes "yes"
text tno "no"
global stk long 16
global top ulong 1
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emiti writes a signed n; the magnitude is taken as a ulong so the minimum long cannot overflow
fn emiti n long to void
if lt n 0
emit minus
emitu add bitcast ulong not n 1
else
emitu ulong n
end
end
note a fixed-capacity stack of 16 longs: stk[0..top-1], the top element last; push on a full stack and
note pop on an empty one stop the program (exit 2), since there is no heap to grow into
fn push v long to void
t = get top 0
if eq t 16
exit 2
end
put stk t v
put top 0 add t 1
emit tpush
emiti v
emit nl
end
fn pop to long
t = get top 0
if eq t 0
exit 2
end
put top 0 sub t 1
v = get stk sub t 1
emit tpop
emiti v
emit nl
ret v
end
fn peek to long
v = get stk sub get top 0 1
emit tpeek
emiti v
emit nl
ret v
end
fn empty to bool
e = eq get top 0 0
emit tempty
if e
emit tyes
else
emit tno
end
emit nl
ret e
end
fn main to int
e = empty
push 10
push -20
push 30
v = peek
emit tsize
emitu get top 0
emit nl
v = pop
v = pop
e = empty
v = pop
e = empty
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
empty: yes
push 10
push -20
push 30
peek 30
size 3
pop 30
pop -20
empty: no
pop 10
empty: yes
</pre>
